numerical_recomputation_scope: No new fits or AUC recomputation in this agent; parent data agent independently verifies raw-score numerical summaries. Values here are read from their bound artifacts.

reuse_without_new_generation: fresh outer-task refits/nested calibration on the frozen corpus
candidate-target reconstruction and independent label adjudication
baseline comparisons using saved common trajectories where valid
Peer-dynamics exact-executor gap can be closed by recovered source or a new versioned offline refit on existing traces; it does not itself require new model generations.
new_generation_needed_for: new live prompt/output contract or unavailable observables
real timestamped synchronized-fleet stopping and total-peer-cost claims
untouched confirmatory paired evaluation of a frozen policy
before_generation: consolidate complete accepted local results with hashes and claim scope
reject partial/contaminated variants and avoid selecting policies on their evaluation scores
choose one practical deployment target and a protocol-capable response contract
serialize actual scoring/transformation/calibration artifact;freeze cost/threshold/baselines and accuracy tolerance before evaluation

important_qualifications: Raw task-held-out OOF AUCs from newer selected/committee analyses are distinct from non-nested reporting Platt metrics.
Candidate-level committee AUC,selected-answer decision AUC,and response-boundary stopping utility use different targets and populations.
AUC>=.95 historical gate does not establish useful stopping,calibration,savings or accuracy preservation.
Untracked local result bundles require explicit packaging/provenance before being described as GitHub-published scientific evidence.
Actual completed evidence and implemented infrastructure must remain separate.
